notes.title: 【Yudian Breaking News】Revival Cards - Revival and Exploration
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/ac34ad06fc63ec4a77d973872e5e7b098a7b9cd7.png"][/img][/p][p]The oriental ancient-style simulation business game [i]Revival and Exploration[/i] will launch the "Relic Realms" update on September 11, 2025. Today, the exclusive news we bring to all City Lords is an introduction to the brand-new gameplay/activity – "Revival Cards" is about to launch! Let's enjoy the exciting and thrilling Revival Cards together![/p][p][/p][h3][b]I. Unlock Conditions[/b][/h3][p]1.Clear the Level 50 Injured Soul Bird dungeon, and the Earth God will grant you the blueprint for the Amusement Table building through a dialogue.[/p][p]2.After constructing the Amusement Table, click the corresponding function button on the Amusement Table to enter the Revival Cards interface.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/af257c4404d0de6b4d0ce3e9569e5ec235fdd206.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]II. Gameplay Introduction[/b][/h3][p]Players can obtain various cards by meeting different conditions (see the Collection for detailed acquisition methods).[/p][p]After collecting a certain number of cards, you can select and form them into a deck. Each card has unique attributes and special effects, and some card combinations can trigger special set effects—therefore, it is necessary to arrange the cards in the deck reasonably.[/p][p]Once the deck is formed, you can click the difficulty selection on the main interface to start card battles.[/p][p]By collecting cards and engaging in card battles, you can complete certain achievements and claim corresponding rewards in the Achievement interface.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/b193c38327eb3208e9cb8d951a9ee0dd789889e3.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/bdddda395431050912f5884e38035cb171546fcc.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/a5510d5132f24d70510103ac88af64cce9cfd03a.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/8991f7d465826869548d5f432582d87222118338.png"][/img][/p]

notes.title: 【Yudian Breaking News】Ancient Relic Hunt - Revival and Exploration
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/ac34ad06fc63ec4a77d973872e5e7b098a7b9cd7.png"][/img][/p][p]The oriental ancient-style simulation business game [i]Revival and Exploration[/i] will launch the "Relic Realms" update on September 11, 2025. Today, the breaking news we bring to all City Lords is an introduction to the brand-new gameplay/event: "Ancient Relic Hunt" is about to launch, and an archaeological boom has swept across the Yudian Continent![/p][p][/p][h3][b]I. Ancient Relic Hunt[/b][/h3][p][b]1.Unlock Conditions[/b][/p][p]1)Unlock the Qingxiao Tribe and reach Reputation Level 2.[/p][p]2)Complete the designated event(s) to unlock the "Ancient Relic Hunt" gameplay.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/4b03f083da5514a0d58800b853449975fe044612.png"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]2.Gameplay Introduction[/b][/p][p]Daily, players can travel to various tribes to conduct Ancient Relic Hunts. Each tribe provides a free location for a buried ancient relic chest every day; this area will be marked on the map, and special effects will also be used to highlight it on the map.[/p][p]Players can dispatch characters to this area for the Ancient Relic Hunt. During the hunt, there is a chance to dig up the ancient relic chest. Using the new exploration method—Ancient Relic Hunt—will increase the probability of finding the chest. Opening the ancient relic chest allows players to obtain various ancient relic shards.[/p][p]Once the ancient relic chest is acquired, the Ancient Relic Hunt is considered complete. If more ancient relic shards are needed, players can spend copper coins in the tribe to obtain additional clues to the locations where ancient relic chests appear.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/a13dbe99678a15de6ceb58e3c0d83a97f92f7da4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/b498a81decaf47c9c35a62808368d01be6782cd4.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/a47fb8b07de3c52acfb80997c964c89175f0faab.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]II. Ancient Relic Restoration[/b][/h3][p][b]1.Unlock Conditions[/b][/p][p]1)Complete 1 Ancient Relic Hunt and obtain any ancient relic shard.[/p][p]2)Construct the building "Ancient Relic Pavilion".[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/867073c313d859d8bfa9a86f6847d62fedffceea.png"][/img][/p][p][b]2.Gameplay Introduction[/b][/p][p]A new building blueprint – "Ancient Relic Pavilion" – will be granted when the function is unlocked.[/p][p]What is obtained from the Ancient Relic Hunt are ancient relic shards. To acquire a complete ancient relic, you need to use the collected shards to restore it in the Ancient Relic Pavilion.[/p][p]There are various ancient relics on the Yudian Continent. Only a small number of ancient relic blueprints are recorded in the Ancient Relic Pavilion, while some precious and legendary ancient relic blueprints can be unlocked through different tribes.[/p][p]You can start restoring an ancient relic once you select the one you want. The relic will be restored once the designated area is filled with ancient relic shards. Different ancient relics consist of different entries; the more the entries of the shards used match those of the relic, the more perfect the restored relic will be.[/p][p]The restoration is completed and the ancient relic is obtained once the designated area is fully filled with shards.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/6ca781f3c8951698d88cd2c096a12be7bee91c99.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/0779c034d9ba76b30192df4367a8cab1a37591e2.png"][/img][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/4115e64fbf5874ab0546a5fd08dbca56134d159d.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]III. Ancient Relic Exhibition[/b][/h3][p][b]1.Unlock Condition[/b][/p][p]Construct the building "Ancient Relic Pavilion".[/p][p][/p][p][b]2.Gameplay Introduction[/b][/p][p]In addition to restoring ancient relics, the Ancient Relic Pavilion also allows you to exhibit various restored ancient relics.[/p][p]Other players can view the ancient relics on display in your Ancient Relic Pavilion—show off the various ancient relics you have collected and restored to other players![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/2c19adc0baf7b558ca749e8f902318972c4ee652.png"][/img][/p][h3][b]IV. Related Function Expansions[/b][/h3][p]1.The upper limit of Tribe Reputation Level is expanded from Level 6 to Level 10.[/p][p]2.The Tribe Reputation Privileges are restructured, with new privilege effects related to the "Ancient Relic Hunt" added.[/p][p]3.Visitors are now able to purchase restored ancient relics.[/p]

notes.title: 【Yudian Breaking News】Ephemera:YanXin - Revival and Exploration
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/e407076c2db5af678377859dd0399fa53ee6fc65.png"][/img][/p][p]The oriental ancient-style simulation business game [i]Revival and Exploration[/i] will launch the "Relic Realms" update on September 11, 2025. Today, the breaking news we bring to all city lords is the brand-new character—"Ephemera:YanXin"! Let's enjoy the extremely gorgeous yet dangerous "fireworks" together![/p][p][/p][h3][b]I. "Honeysuckle" - Heart Selection Bond[/b][/h3][p][b]1. Unlock Conditions[/b][/p][p]Accumulate 4 rounds of Journey Bonding[/p][p][b]2. Event Time[/b][/p][p]2025/9/11 after update - 2025/10/2 8:29 (21 days duration)[/p][p][b]3. Event Description[/b][/p][p]Players can select the Legendary Character "YanXin (Shadow Guard)" or "MoYu (Painter)" as their Heart Selection character in "Heart Selection character". After selection, there is a 50% probability that the obtained Legendary Character will be the Heart Selection character;[/p][p]During the event, the Legendary Character "YanXin (Shadow Guard)" can only be obtained through "Heart Selection character". After the event ends, "YanXin (Shadow Guard)" will be added to "Journey Bonding" in the next "Heart Selection Bond" update. [/p][p]For detailed rules, please check the Bonding interface.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]II. Character Introduction: "Yanxin"[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/55cef59aec7bac30ed59978909755e09ff4934ba.png"][/img][/p][p]"Under the beautiful fireworks, danger also lurks."[/p][p][/p][p]Quality: Legendary[/p][p]Class: Shadow Guard[/p][p]Position: Damage Dealer[/p][p][/p][p]Character Positioning:[/p][p]YanXin can deal delayed area true damage in battles.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Charged Skill:[/b][/p][p]\[Firework Dance]Attacks a single enemy target, dealing skill damage and extending all debuffs it carries by 1 turn.[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/12c5d5a70745dc179dca51c2f0d1667450b36b02.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Traits:[/b][/p][p]\[Momentary Radiance]: After unleashing a Charged Skill, applies 1 stack of \[Gunpowder] to the Charged Skill's target, lasting until the end of the battle.[/p][p]\[Gunpowder]: Detonates when the bearer is hit by a skill attack, dealing True Damage to all units within the 3x3 grid centered on the bearer. Removed after detonation. Cannot be stacked or dispelled.[/p][p][/p][p]\[Improved Formula]: Converts a certain percentage of YanXin's own Critical Rate and Critical Damage into additional Attack for herself.[/p][p][/p][p]\[Niter Flower]: Increases YanXin's Speed. When \[Gunpowder] detonates, additionally applies \[Burn] to the bearer for a certain number of turns.[/p][p]\[Burn]: Increases all Damage taken by the bearer, with an extra increase to True Damage taken. Cannot be stacked or dispelled.[/p][p][/p][p][b]Character Story:[/b][/p][p]YanXin grew up in a family of firework craftsmen and had a great passion for making fireworks.[/p][p]Though her father warned her about the dangers of gunpowder, the young YanXin could not understand it at the time.[/p][p]After witnessing the devastating destruction caused by gunpowder, YanXin made up her mind...[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/0511122d2efdbd27ffcc3b7ca5567a17c4353062.png"][/img][/p][p](Unlocks this character's avatar after obtaining the character)[/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/083e0ef80ad42e5d5df0e7d9c707f7fb95a2a5eb.png"][/img][/p][p](Unlocks this character's avatar after completing the character compendium challenge \[Pinnacle of Excellence])[/p]

notes.title: The new Craftsman character "XuanShu" debuts in Revival and Exploration.
notes.content: [p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/6937bd0ed4aad3f095bb05971368ceaf2cfb4efe.png"][/img][/p][p]Revival and Exploration will welcome the new craftsman "XuanShu" on July 31! Gifted since childhood, XuanShu was chosen by the Guardian Spirit to become the only one able to see and communicate with it. As she grew older, she became well-read and highly skilled, seeking to enrich her life and find inner fulfillment. Upon learning that the Guardian Spirit would disappear upon her coming of age, XuanShu resolved to use Organ Technique to create a body for the Guardian Spirit, ultimately preserving this precious friendship and proving herself a truly unique existence in the world.[/p][p][/p][p][b]I. "Inspiration Bestowed" Heart Selection Bond[/b][/p][p][b]1. Unlock Conditions[/b][/p][p]Accumulate 4 rounds of Journey Bonding[/p][p][b]2. Event Time[/b][/p][p]2025/7/31 after update - 2025/8/21 8:29 (21 days duration)[/p][p][b]3. Event Description[/b] [/p][p]Players can select the legendary character "XuanShu (Craftsman)" or "Jiu (Painter)" as their Heart Selection character in "Heart Selection Bond". After selection, obtaining a legendary character has a 50% chance to be the selected character; during the event, the legendary character "XuanShu (Craftsman)" can only be obtained in "Heart Selection Bond". After the event, "XuanShu (Craftsman)" will be added to "Journey Bonding" in the next "Heart Selection Bond" update. For detailed rules, please check the Bonding interface.[/p][p][/p][p][b]II. "XuanShu" Character Introduction[/b][/p][p][img src="https://image.duoyi.com/com/76523/pic/7cbff434eaa04d77aeecdaa1ffa03cbf.png"][/img][/p][p]"With these hands, I can craft anything."[/p][p][/p][p]Quality: Legendary[/p][p]Class: Craftsman[/p][p]Role: DPS[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Character Role:[/b][/p][p]XuanShu is a special craftsman character who, when hired, gains a special Genius \[inspiration doll] that does not occupy the number of Genius plays.[/p][p]As XuanShu grows, the \[inspiration doll] also gains new powers, reducing all craftsmen's crafting time and resource consumption in the city.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://image.duoyi.com/com/76523/pic/0258f2aa028d4387bc58bc86d602391b.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Features:[/b][/p][p]\[Art of Servitude]: XuanShu's own productivity is increased. When hired, XuanShu automatically deploys the Genius \[inspiration doll]. \[inspiration doll] does not occupy the number of Genius plays, and cannot participate in Genius enlightenment and Genius enchantment.[/p][p]\[Multi-task Operation (unlocked at 3 stars)]: XuanShu's own production efficiency is increased. \[inspiration doll]'s quality and attributes are enhanced, and it gains a new feature that reduces all craftsmen's crafting resource consumption in the city. This Genius feature cannot stack.[/p][p]\[Inspiration Burst (unlocked at 6 stars)]: XuanShu's chance to craft high-quality equipment is increased. \[inspiration doll]'s quality and attributes are enhanced, and it gains a new feature that reduces all craftsmen's production time in the city. This Genius feature cannot stack.[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://image.duoyi.com/com/76523/pic/c230449fce534b8cb3133a9193103992.gif"][/img][/p][p][b]Charge Skill:[/b][/p][p]\[Thunder at first sight] summons lightning in the enemy camp, striking multiple times at random to deal skill damage. The final lightning strike increases all damage the target receives.[/p][p] [/p][p][b]Character Story:[/b][/p][p]XuanShu, a genius girl renowned far and wide, was well-read from a young age.[/p][p]She never had friends her own age, yet never felt lonely.[/p][p]In her youth, she suddenly devoted herself to studying Organ Technique and traveled far from home. What was the reason behind this?[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://image.duoyi.com/com/76523/pic/13c50562f3be48b3a8fef99066855a62.PNG"][/img][/p][p](Unlocks this character's avatar after obtaining the character)[/p][p] [/p][p][img src="https://image.duoyi.com/com/76523/pic/f146f533ad684ffe87e0d79de8a1fa4b.PNG"][/img][/p][p](Unlocks this character's avatar after completing the character compendium challenge \[Pinnacle of Excellence])[/p]

notes.title: Revival and Exploration participates in the 2025 Steam China Showcase!
notes.content: [p]The Oriental ancient-style simulation management game [i]Revival and Exploration[/i] is participating in the Steam China Showcase held from July 23rd to July 29th! Build a prosperous town and adventure freely on this continent![/p][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/8b65c2e84155edb521eacb5b2749015405564da1.png"][/img][/p][h2]About [i]Revival and Exploration[/i]:[/h2][p][i]Revival and Exploration[/i] is an oriental simulation game. Decorate your town with diverse landscapes and buildings, recruit residents to live in, and build a thriving city! You can also lead armed residents on traveling to different landscapes such as grassland, desert, snow, and volcanoes.[/p][p][/p][h2]Game Features:[/h2][p][/p][h3]Build Your Town From a Ruin[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3382170/extras/%E5%BB%BA%E9%80%A0%E5%9F%8E%E9%95%87%EF%BC%8C%E5%86%8D%E7%8E%B0%E7%B9%81%E8%8D%A3.gif?t=1747879956"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]As your city rivals, the appearance of the buildings will change—from thatched huts to grand mansions, from deserted place to thriving town. Try to use the unique ancient Oriental-style landscape to build up a staggering, prosperous, and lively paradise![/p][p][/p][h3]Peace Life with Diverse Residents[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3382170/extras/%E5%B0%8F%E5%9F%8E%E7%83%9F%E7%81%AB%EF%BC%8C%E6%82%A0%E9%97%B2%E6%97%A5%E5%B8%B8%EF%BC%88%E8%BF%AD%E4%BB%A3%EF%BC%89.gif?t=1747879956"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Recruit a variety of classes and different-looking residents! The characters you recruit will live in your city and take up different activities. As your city grows, you can recruit more people to join this city. Every day you'll see them strolling the streets, chatting with each other, or working hard. There are time and weather systems in the game, forming a dynamic cityscape![/p][p][/p][h3]Craft Equipment, Develop Trade[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3382170/extras/%E5%88%B6%E4%BD%9C%E8%A3%85%E5%A4%87%EF%BC%8C%E5%8F%91%E5%B1%95%E8%B4%B8%E6%98%93.gif?t=1747879956"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Trade with merchants for resources to upgrade your city! Residents with crafting abilities can create a wide variety of equipment. These armaments can be equipped for your residents to make it easier to defeat enemies when they explore, but also can be traded as commodities. Use earnings to upgrade your building and create a prosperous business center![/p][p][/p][h3]Vast Map, Free Exploration[/h3][p][/p][p][img src="https://shared.akamai.steamstatic.com/store_item_assets/steam/apps/3382170/extras/%E5%B9%BF%E8%A2%A4%E5%9C%B0%E5%9B%BE%EF%BC%8C%E8%87%AA%E7%94%B1%E6%8E%A2%E9%99%A9.gif?t=1747879956"][/img][/p][p][/p][p]Seamless maps are available for free exploration! Command your residents to explore the wild, gather resources, or fight for treasure. Train your residents, and lead them deeper into the mists to fight stronger enemies, spreading your name across the entire continent![/p][p][/p][p]— The Revival and Exploration Project Team[/p]

notes.title: Like a Breeze, Swift as a Cloud - The New General Character "HuaFeng"
notes.content:
[p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/ac573a654fea01860b506083cc1d4059b0937c8b.png"][/img][/p][p]"Revival and Exploration" Welcomes New General "HuaFeng" on June 19th![/p][p]Orphaned since childhood, Windstride knew only her master—a once-ambitious wanderer who vowed to traverse every corner of the Yudian Continent, yet now dwells quietly in a remote mountain village. "Someday," she vowed, "I too shall journey beyond these peaks, retracing my master's footsteps to measure this vast land."[/p][p]Now bearing twin spirit blades—Gentle Breeze and Wandering Cloud—she treads across lands shattered by demonic forces. Her path has led her to the Cliffside Plains... With the whispering wind and drifting clouds as her companions, can she uphold the chivalrous ideals burning in her heart?[/p][p][/p][h3][b]I.【Stormfell Companions】 Choice Wish[/b][/h3][p][b]1.Wish Unlock[/b][/p][p][/p][p]Wish 4 times cumulatively.[/p][p][/p][p][b]2.Activity Time[/b][/p][p][/p][p]2025/6/19 after maintenance - 2025/7/10 8:29[/p][p][/p][p][b]3.Activity Description[/b][/p][p][/p][p]During the 【Choice Wish】, players may select either the Legendary character HuaFeng (General) or Shan Meiren (Chef) as their "Heart's Choice". When obtaining a Legendary character during this period, there's 50% chance it will be your selected Heart's Choice.[/p][p]Note:[/p][p]HuaFeng (General) is exclusively available through 【Choice Wish】 during the event.[/p][p]After the event ends, Huafeng will be added to 【Wish】 in the next update cycle.[/p][p]For detailed rules, visit the Wish interface.[/p][p][/p][h3][b]II. Character Introduction: "HuaFeng"[/b][/h3][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/055ed3636641cb03f26c1a73ab281e3b67930cc8.png"][/img][/p][p]"Go with the wind.”[/p][p][/p][p][b]Rarity:[/b] Legendary
[b]Class:[/b] General
[b]Role:[/b] Vanguard[/p][p][/p][p][b]Character Overview:[/b][/p][p]Windstride is an aggressive warrior who grows stronger when facing powerful foes, specializing in relentless pursuit attacks that deal basic attack damage.[/p][list][*][p]After executing a pursuit attack, Windstride marks the target with [b]【Wind Blade】[/b], increasing their chance of receiving critical hits.[/p][/*][*][p]Enemies affected by [b]【Wind Blade】[/b], will suffer [b]【Wind Wound】[/b] upon being hit by basic attacks, increasing all damage they receive.[/p][/*][*][p]When using the charged skill, Windstride unleashes a multi-hit pursuit attack on a single enemy, dealing basic attack damage.[/p][/*][/list][p][img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/9b5c093913288ded8e940904c8fa9adb3fd9d983.gif"][/img][/p][p][/p][p][b]Traits:[/b][/p][list][*][p]【Qingfeng Liuyun】: Gain Pursuit:Perform an additional attack after a normal attack.[/p][/*][*][p]【Wind Blade】: Deals additional damage to enemies with 【Wind Blade】. When enemies with 【Wind Blade】 attack HuaFeng, damage taken is reduced.[/p][/*][*][p]【Strong Wind】: After any enemy unit takes action or HuaFeng takes pursues, HuaFeng adds 1 layer of 【Combo】.[/p][/*][*][p]【Combo】: ATK increased,can stack up to 15 layers. When the number of layers reaches the upper limit, act again immediately, and remove all 【Combo】 after acting again.[/p][/*][/list][p][img notes.title: "Revival & Exploration" Official Launch! Build a cozy city together!
notes.content:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/ba696cc8c8445a66b914d28b4c7b05e6926b6566.png[/img]
 "Revival & Exploration" officially launched on Steam on May 22, and is free to play. We welcome everyone to download and experience it!

[h1] 1. Build a beautiful city as you wish. [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/2c57e54e74f20c18b4cae2268a02c6d372582d65.png[/img]
In a prosperous and peaceful corner of the Yudian continent, a small town sits by the cliff, where residents work at sunrise and return at sunset, living a happy and tranquil life. But the wars ignited by the demons shattered the town’s peace, and the cliffside town was destroyed overnight, leaving only ruins. As the lord, you must shoulder the responsibility to rebuild the city with the residents, develop trade, and explore various terrains such as deserts, swamps, and ice fields. Befriend local tribes, meet new friends, and ultimately establish a town more glorious than ever before!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/8d2f01c0a221afc5ea747abb56947f7e3d1f80ea.png[/img]
 In the world of Revival & Exploration, you’ll gather materials through outdoor exploration, construct the town, craft equipment to sell to visitors, and earn funds to purchase more land and buildings, boosting your town’s prosperity. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/48cd5c7a6e08c424270f6a43f5ff98ec9fe8431b.png[/img]
The game features soft, bright colors and a cute, chibi art style, accompanied by cheerful and pleasant background music. All town residents work at sunrise and rest at sunset, and will proactively help with transporting materials or repairing houses. You can leisurely plan your city layout or dispatch people to explore at any time, returning together with loads of materials. 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/df760c2e42c73dd08c88961662b707ff32fb9b44.png[/img]
There are over a dozen unique professions in the game, and different buildings have distinct functions: the tailor shop can craft lightweight gear, the eatery continuously sells specialty snacks, and the magic cannon can automatically attack incoming enemies. Road planning is also a skill—connecting buildings yields full benefits, and pedestrians move much faster on roads. To get rich, build roads first!

[h1] 2. Merchants gather, trade connects the world. [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/5fdc217cf5aa7eddfe061602fc8380a28f6b631a.png[/img]
As your city grows, more and more merchants and visitors will come to this new city on the plains. You can bargain for big profits, make friends and sell at low prices, or even persuade guests to swap for their preferred items. Respond actively to the needs of visitors and merchants, and turn your city into a prosperous trade center!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/a1525d85bed382b8efe29ff28c7ed84537e1a750.png[/img]

In Yudian, you’ll encounter all kinds of adventures beyond managing your own land. You might meet the three wandering tanuki brothers, a reclusive alchemy master, or a mysterious little beggar... 

[h1]3. Break through the fog, seek treasures, and enjoy adventure. [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/6d7a73f6433e020681557c4cd9a3e6a00d43878b.png[/img]
The Yudian continent offers a vast space for lords to freely explore, including volcanoes, ice fields, ruins, and other unique terrains. Most areas on the map are shrouded in thick fog, hiding many monsters, treasures, and secret realms. Various ancient ruins and treasures await you! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/f249ce229e55c05843b1eff77a81cde337907a32.png[/img]
Many tribes are scattered across Yudian, living in isolation. You can meet all kinds of people, help them solve problems, build relationships, and exchange resources! Try to unite the tribes and work together to build the town and resist demon invasions! 

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/ad1b9119c02b0e5f52611b59e574df2705cfc3f9.png[/img]
The charm of Revival & Exploration is not just in construction and gathering, but in the clever integration of character development and open-world exploration. The town you carefully manage will support your adventures, while the treasures you find will help your city thrive even more. Building and exploring go hand in hand, just as the game’s name suggests. 

[h1]4. Official launch—explore Yudian freely. [/h1]

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/934e6dcefb565e430e51fbeb80b763ae9a4aef69.png[/img]
A paradise always exists, and beautiful landscapes fill your dreams. If you’re interested in city management and want to build your own utopia, or if you prefer character development and want to see your rare residents embark on adventures, welcome to the world of Revival & Exploration! On May 22, let’s meet in Yudian and become the lord of a new continent!

notes.title: Revival and Exploration Goes Live on May 22!
notes.content:
Revival and Exploration goes live on Steam on May 21(PT), 2025. Build the Cozy City with us!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/61392bb471399c7044626fb26f5783dc35ada382.jpg[/img] 

The land of Yudian is bursting with spiritual energy. It's a resource-rich continent with stunning scenery and crystal-clear waters—a true paradise. But now, the demon tribe has eyes on this fertile land and has begun their invasion. To protect this haven, you'll rebuild from scratch after your city is attacked, carefully plan your town's growth, expand into forests, snowy fields, volcanoes, and more, meet new friends, and ultimately create a city even more glorious than before!

[h3]Development & Prosperity[/h3]

In Revival and Exploration, you'll head out on adventures to gather materials, build up your town, craft weapons to sell to visitors and merchants for funds, and buy more land and buildings to boost your town's prosperity.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/b32ffd6747557aa3985b5dcdd90856305fd54de7.png[/img]

No complicated quests or micromanaging here. Residents go about their day—working at sunrise, resting at sunset—and will jump in to help move materials or fix up buildings when needed. You can chill out and design your city layout, watching your home transform from ruins to a thriving hub. Or, send your residents out exploring and bring back loads of loot together.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/04bac7bcf2fc5bfa50055577a96a255e9ad39b17.png[/img]

As your city grows, more merchants and visitors will get curious about this new town on the plains and come to check it out. Some will wander around sightseeing, others will hang out at the inn. You can haggle for big profits, make friends offer sweet deals, or even talk guests into swapping for their favorite items. A thriving city needs a steady flow of funds—so meet the needs of visitors and merchants, and turn your town into a bustling trade center!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/fa1b082a1c371555c6ffd841b54a03c17d24b317.png[/img]

[h3]World Exploration[/h3]

Resources around your town are limited. When your town gets big and hits a bottleneck, why not venture deeper into Yudian for treasure and adventure? The continent is huge, with volcanoes, icy plains, ruins, and more to explore.

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/9cd8d6601c29ef40750e38ac0ace1971204b67ca.png[/img]

Travel through deserts and swamps, and you'll discover your town isn't the only human settlement out there. Many ancient and mysterious tribes are scattered across Yudian, but due to demon attacks or old traditions, they've stayed isolated. Meet all kinds of people, help them out, build relationships, and trade resources. Try uniting the tribes, working together to build up your town and fend off the demon invasion—become the pillar of Yudian!

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45354693/b0e2ff0401b3a9dd560eb57606690e51a942ab0a.png[/img]

Revival and Exploration is going to be released on May 22! Follow us and add Revival and Exploration to your wishlist, stay tuned for all the latest news!
